jobs.title: Digital Content Strategist
jobs.description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN.

To see what it’s like to work at CNN, follow @WBDLife on  Instagram  and  X !

Your New Role...

The Digital Content Strategist for CNN Underscored is responsible for creating high‑impact, social‑first content designed to drive reach and shares across TikTok and Instagram. This role will help us engage users actively seeking to make informed decisions on how they buy, use or own products. Content must translate complex reviews, testing insights and product tradeoffs into clear, useful and trustworthy social storytelling that helps our audience evaluate options and build confidence in decisions. This role focuses on constant ideation and pitching of new formats, angles, and concepts, then rapidly evolving those approaches based on audience insights and performance data. The strategist partners cross‑functionally with social, editorial, video, and commerce teams to develop, package, and publish content that aligns with Underscored’s brand voice and its service-driven, decision-support mission. Success in this role requires balancing creativity with clarity, crafting content that is engaging as well as useful and actionable.

Your Role Accountabilities...

Social Strategy & Execution: Drive TikTok and Instagram reach and engagement through content that simplifies decisions, highlights product tradeoffs and delivers clear, actionable value to a high-intent audience.
Independently produce 4-5  
vertical video and graphics weekly, programming and posting in-feed across both platforms.

Create daily content for our Instagram story series, translating social first and editorial pieces into high-performing posts. 

Maintain a forward‑looking content calendar in partnership with the Social Lead.

Continuously test and refine hooks, captions, thumbnails, and structure to improve performance.

Creative Development & Pitching: Proactively pitch a steady stream of new content ideas, product angles, and franchise concepts that directly support Underscored’s brand and KPI goals.
Own and spot timely content opportunities, quickly turning them into relevant social content.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Partner with editorial teams to turn articles and reviews into clear, social-first concepts that preserve the integrity of our testing, expertise and recommendations while making them engaging and immediately informative.

Data & Reporting: Monitor shifts in design, audio, editing styles, creator strategies, and platform trends, then share clear insights and next steps with the team.
Track and analyze monthly performance metrics, turning data into actionable recommendations that inform future content and strategy.

Your Qualifications & Experience...

Content Background: 3+ years of experience independently ideating, creating, publishing, and optimizing social-first content across Instagram, TikTok, or other digital platforms.

Strategic Thinking & Pitching: Ability to connect creative concepts to KPI goals and articulate why an idea will perform, using data, insights, or past results.

Audience Intent Awareness: Strong understanding of high-intent, utility-driven audiences and an ability to create content aimed at driving action and supporting decision-making rather than passive consumption.

Proactive problem‑solving: Instinct to explore solutions independently before seeking guidance. Approach challenges with a solutions‑first mindset, thinking through questions and possible answers or paths toward resolution.

Adaptability & Ownership: Self‑starter attitude; able to anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and pivot quickly when priorities shift.

Independent Content Creation: Comfortable producing vertical video and social-first content independently, from ideation to scheduling. Confident adapting to platform best practices and shifts in strategy.

Copywriting: Strong ability to craft platform-specific hooks, captions and framing that quickly communicate value, differentiate options and guide users toward clearer understanding.

Trend Monitoring: Ability to identify early platform trends and translate them into actionable and relevant content ideas.

Data Analysis: Comfort reviewing analytics, diagnosing performance, and turning data into clear recommendations.

Proficient in Adobe Premiere, Canva, Microsoft Office and various social scheduling tools (Dash Social, Sprout Social).

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, skill set, experience, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of Warner Bros. Discovery’s total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $64,264.00 - $119,348.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Copy
jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

About The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Creative Director, Copy to join our growing in-house creative team focused on OpenAI’s business audiences. In this role, you’ll help define how we communicate the value of OpenAI to organizations - from growing businesses and startups to global enterprises and developers building with our technology.

You’ll concept and write across integrated campaigns, product launches, customer stories, events, and other brand moments. You’ll translate complex products, technical capabilities, and business outcomes into clear, compelling ideas that resonate with decision-makers, builders, and teams adopting AI.

This is a deeply hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable developing a big campaign platform, shaping a messaging framework, writing a film script, or refining a headline. You’ll work closely with design, production, product marketing, and communications from the earliest stages of an idea through execution.

To us, creativity is a team sport. Ideas get better when you talk them through and build on each other’s thinking. We value curiosity over certainty, kindness over ego, and the ability to balance creative ambition with clarity and decisiveness.

This role is based in New York, NY. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role you will

Concept and write integrated brand campaigns for OpenAI’s business audiences
Translate complex products, technical capabilities, and use cases into clear, human, and emotionally resonant stories
Develop campaign platforms, messaging frameworks, headlines, scripts, manifestos, and narrative systems
Create work that connects OpenAI’s products to meaningful business challenges and outcomes
Shape how OpenAI speaks to business leaders, technical decision-makers, developers, and teams adopting AI
Write across customer stories, product launches, films, digital experiences, events, social content, and executive communications
Partner closely with design, motion, production, brand strategy, and agency teams to bring ideas to life
Collaborate with Product Marketing, Sales, Product, Communications, and other partners to understand audiences and business priorities
Build flexible messaging systems that can work across industries, audiences, markets, and channels
Evolve and steward OpenAI’s voice and tone across business communications
Present creative ideas and explain the thinking behind them to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders
Move fluidly between high-level concepts and detailed execution, staying close to the work throughout the process
Manage multiple complex projects, evolving inputs, and compressed timelines with clarity and confidence
Help challenge conventions about what enterprise and technology marketing can look and sound like

You might thrive in this role if you

Have 10+ years of experience writing for brands, gained at a creative agency known for creative excellence and/or in-house at a modern technology company, with experience in both strongly preferred
Are an exceptional writer and conceptual thinker with a portfolio of distinctive, integrated creative work
Have experience writing for B2B, enterprise, developer, or other technically sophisticated audiences
Can make complex products and technical concepts understandable without flattening their meaning
Understand how to connect product capabilities to customer needs, organizational change, and meaningful business outcomes
Can move comfortably between campaign concepts, messaging strategy, scripts, headlines, long-form narratives, and detailed copy
Have deep fluency in voice, tone, rhythm, structure, and storytelling
Can find a compelling creative idea in an ambiguous brief—or help shape the brief when one doesn’t yet exist
Enjoy building ideas collaboratively with designers, strategists, producers, and cross-functional partners
Can advocate for ambitious creative work while responding constructively to strategic, technical, and commercial constraints
Operate autonomously and take strong ownership of your work from concept through execution
Balance creativity with the clarity, credibility, and precision required for business audiences
Are comfortable working across multiple projects and adapting quickly as priorities and inputs evolve

Nice to have

Experience working with enterprise technology, developer platforms, SaaS products, or emerging categories
Experience writing customer stories that connect individual experiences with broader organizational impact
Familiarity with the needs of enterprise buyers, technical evaluators, developers, and business leaders
Experience with executive storytelling, major industry events, or sales-enablement narratives
Background in editorial, long-form storytelling, filmmaking, or documentary work
Familiarity with integrated campaign development and scalable brand systems
Curiosity about AI, the future of work, and how technology changes the way organizations operate and create

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
MEDHOST, a division of Harris; is seeking a hands-on B2B marketer who helps bring healthcare technology solutions to market through product marketing, integrated campaigns, digital marketing, sales enablement, and audience-focused messaging. This role works across teams to turn product, market, customer, and business priorities into go-to-market programs, campaigns, and sales-facing deliverables. The position also uses generative AI, market and competitive research, and performance data to improve marketing execution and decision-making.

This role requires a versatile marketer who can move across disciplines, connect market and customer needs to marketing action, collaborate effectively, and carry initiatives from planning through execution and optimization. The position also uses generative AI, market and competitive research, and performance data to improve marketing execution and decision-making.

This is a remote role eligible to anyone in the U.S. and the role will include up to 10% travel within the U.S.

Primary Responsibilities

Support go-to-market strategies and product launches for new solutions, enhancements, partnerships, and other business initiatives, coordinating messaging, audiences, assets, channels, and timelines.
Translate product capabilities, market needs, and complex healthcare and technology information into clear value propositions, differentiators, proof points, and audience-focused messaging.
Partner cross-functionally with R&D, Sales, Customer Success, subject-matter experts, and other stakeholders to understand product direction, customer needs, buyer priorities, and market opportunities.
Develop and execute product marketing and sales enablement deliverables, including launch materials, campaign assets, webpages, presentations, sales tools, proposals, RFP/RFI content, and customer communications.
Write and edit marketing and sales communications for clarity, persuasion, accuracy, audience relevance, and brand consistency.
Apply generative AI for research, analysis, ideation, content development, and marketing workflow improvement.
Develop and refine AI prompts and repeatable workflows, applying professional judgment to review outputs for accuracy, relevance, audience fit, and brand alignment.
Plan and execute integrated marketing initiatives across web, email, search, social, webinars, customer communications, and sales enablement, including audience targeting, campaign activation, and performance measurement.
Support website content, SEO, and AI visibility, such as AEO/AIO, along with landing pages, and digital experiences that improve visibility, engagement, and conversion.
Conduct market, customer, audience, and competitive research and contribute insights that inform positioning, messaging, campaigns, and sales conversations.
Analyze marketing performance, market insights, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities and recommend improvements to marketing programs.
Manage multiple projects from planning through completion while maintaining quality, accuracy, organization, and deadlines.
Maintain the effectiveness and implementation of the MEDHOST Quality Management System and meet applicable regulatory requirements as needed.
Responsible for QMS procedures listed in QMS Procedure Crosswalk found in QMS Manual as applicable.
Other duties as assigned.

Requirements & Other Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
4+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience across product marketing, integrated marketing, digital marketing, messaging, demand generation, or go-to-market execution.
Healthcare technology, healthcare IT, enterprise technology, or similarly complex B2B experience preferred, with familiarity with healthcare industry terminology and market dynamics also preferred.
Experience supporting product launches, positioning, buyer messaging, and sales enablement, with a strong understanding of customer value and differentiation.
Practical proficiency using generative AI, prompting, and AI-assisted workflows in professional marketing.
Strong writing, editing, and messaging skills, including the ability to simplify complex healthcare, technology, and business concepts for different audiences.
Demonstrated ability to execute integrated and digital marketing across web, email, search, social media, and content channels, including SEO and emerging AI visibility practices such as AEO/AIO.
Familiarity with conducting market, audience, or competitive research and translating findings into actionable marketing recommendations.
Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, content management, analytics, research, and other marketing technology platforms.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and modern marketing productivity tools.
Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret marketing data and performance metrics to guide decisions and improvements.
Strong collaboration, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with peers, leadership, customers, partners, and vendors.
Strong project-management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to independently execute work within established strategic direction.
Adaptability, curiosity, and willingness to develop new capabilities as marketing practices and technology evolve.

What We Offer

Plenty of opportunities to grow your career
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, FSA benefits
3 weeks of vacation plus 5 personal days to recharge
401K and Life insurance benefits
Employee stock ownership and RRSP program
A chance to give back through community involvement
Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle

About Us

MEDHOST, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee, is a leading provider of healthcare information technology solutions. Serving healthcare facilities nationwide, MEDHOST offers a comprehensive suite of products, including electronic health records (EHR), financial management systems, and patient engagement platforms. Their mission is to empower healthcare organizations to enhance patient care and improve business operations through innovative, user-friendly solutions. In January 2024, MEDHOST was acquired by N. Harris Computer Corporation, further strengthening its position in the healthcare IT industry.

About Harris Computer

Harris provides mission critical software solutions for the Public Sector, Healthcare, Utilities and Private Sector verticals throughout North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

Working for Harris is the perfect opportunity to fulfill your professional goals as well as achieve your personal dreams!

Our employees enjoy a casual work environment that offers comfort while providing superior service to our customers. We offer a comprehensive benefit package as well as other additional “Perks”!

We empower our employees to make a difference
We have an award-winning culture
We offer opportunity to learn
We are financially strong and we are owned by the largest software company in Canada (CSI)
We have fun!

Follow us on social media to learn more about our company values, culture and initiatives!

Instagram: ⁠@weareharris
LinkedIn: ⁠Harris Computer

jobs.title: Art Director - Minecraft Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
Are you a creative strategist who can balance bold ideas with performance-driven execution? Do you enjoy leading rapid creative iteration, uncovering insights from past campaigns, and translating those learnings into high-impact concepts, tests, and templates? If you're passionate about building creative that drives efficiency, growth, and meaningful audience engagement, read on…

We are seeking an Art Director to own performance marketing creative strategy and rapid iteration across paid media, translating historical in-market learnings into concepts, templates, creative tests, and platform-native assets that improve efficiency and growth for our client, Minecraft.

Our Art Director will partner closely with media, analytics, localization/regional teams, and influencer/creator teams to turn signal into repeatable creative systems. Ideal candidates will have proven experience in both creative strategy and execution roles, where connecting performance insights, platform-native creative, and scalable testing systems were foundational. This role is ideal for someone moving from direct asset creation into strategic direction, with the ability to both make the work and guide others toward stronger performance outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Performance creative strategy: Define paid media creative frameworks across Meta, YouTube, TikTok and other priority channels; codify hooks, formats, messaging, pacing, and platform-native best practices.
Creative testing: Build the learning agenda with media and analytics teams; set hypotheses, variants, audience logic, success metrics, and readout plans for A/B and multivariate tests.
Insight-to-action loop: Translate historical and in-market performance into future creative direction, templates, and standards that improve CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS, and LTV signals.
Execution support: Rapidly concept, storyboard, provide art direction, create and adapt templates, select and/or capture gameplay footage, and support lightweight static and video asset iteration as needed.
Cross-functional partnership: Partner with media, analytics, localization/regional, and influencer/creator teams to connect creative strategy to media plans, measurement, market nuance, and creator amplification.
Systems and playbooks: Maintain performance marketing creative playbooks, test libraries, and modular asset guidance that scales across global campaigns and growth initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS:

6+ years experience in performance marketing creative, paid social and/or digital creative strategy, growth marketing, or related experience.
Proven experience as a personal content creator or hands-on publisher on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Twitch, or similar platforms.
Proven hands-on experience designing and iterating paid social and video assets, with demonstrated proficiency in static design, template development, resizing/versioning, and lightweight video editing workflows.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud specifically Photoshop and Illustrator; comfortable creating, adapting, resizing, and versioning static assets and templates.
Ability to support lightweight video/asset workflows, including concepting, rough cuts, gameplay capture and/or selection, reference development, and creative direction for art or templates.
Fluency with performance metrics and learning agendas, including CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS, LTV signals, audience/placement reads, and test interpretation.
Proven ability to partner with media, analytics, localization/regional, creative, and influencer teams in fast-moving campaign environments.
Animation or motion design capabilities, such as After Effects or similar tools, to support short-form video and performance asset iteration.
Proven understanding of native engagement patterns from direct practice.
Familiarity with modern measurement and marketing technology foundations such as MMM, CAPI, tagging/event signals, and attribution constraints.
Performance-first creative judgment; analytical and hypothesis-driven.
Hybrid maker and leader mindset: able to move quickly from insight to concept to asset, while also setting strategic direction, codifying learnings, and guiding scalable performance creative systems.
Platform-native taste; understands what works in social feeds without losing brand quality.
Required: Gaming, entertainment, creator economy, or culturally driven brand experience.

ATTRIBUTES:

Highly motivated with a passion for innovation and drive to exceed personal goals and client expectations.
Highly adaptable to produce a range of visual styles, and tasks within a project.
Exceptional attention to detail, internal quality control, and excellent craftsmanship.
Ability to describe technical concepts to clients and stakeholders in relatable terms and convey, persuade and sell an artistic vision.
Highly organized – able to independently build, track, and execute tasks from start to finish.
Strong time management abilities to self-manage and adjust to rapidly changing priorities.
A successful track record of creative problem solving for technical and design challenges.
Ability to gracefully lead and work on multiple projects simultaneously under tight deadline pressure with a positive and helpful attitude.

Benefits Overview
:
Medical, dental, vision, basic life/AD&D, long-term disability, and employee assistance programs
Additional voluntary benefits like short-term disability plans and health coverage for dependents
401(k) & HSA
Competitive PTO plan
12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, plus additional floating holidays

new_jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Strategist
new_jobs.description:
MEDHOST, a division of Harris; is seeking a hands-on B2B marketer who helps bring healthcare technology solutions to market through product marketing, integrated campaigns, digital marketing, sales enablement, and audience-focused messaging. This role works across teams to turn product, market, customer, and business priorities into go-to-market programs, campaigns, and sales-facing deliverables. The position also uses generative AI, market and competitive research, and performance data to improve marketing execution and decision-making.

This role requires a versatile marketer who can move across disciplines, connect market and customer needs to marketing action, collaborate effectively, and carry initiatives from planning through execution and optimization. The position also uses generative AI, market and competitive research, and performance data to improve marketing execution and decision-making.

This is a remote role eligible to anyone in the U.S. and the role will include up to 10% travel within the U.S.

Primary Responsibilities

Support go-to-market strategies and product launches for new solutions, enhancements, partnerships, and other business initiatives, coordinating messaging, audiences, assets, channels, and timelines.
Translate product capabilities, market needs, and complex healthcare and technology information into clear value propositions, differentiators, proof points, and audience-focused messaging.
Partner cross-functionally with R&D, Sales, Customer Success, subject-matter experts, and other stakeholders to understand product direction, customer needs, buyer priorities, and market opportunities.
Develop and execute product marketing and sales enablement deliverables, including launch materials, campaign assets, webpages, presentations, sales tools, proposals, RFP/RFI content, and customer communications.
Write and edit marketing and sales communications for clarity, persuasion, accuracy, audience relevance, and brand consistency.
Apply generative AI for research, analysis, ideation, content development, and marketing workflow improvement.
Develop and refine AI prompts and repeatable workflows, applying professional judgment to review outputs for accuracy, relevance, audience fit, and brand alignment.
Plan and execute integrated marketing initiatives across web, email, search, social, webinars, customer communications, and sales enablement, including audience targeting, campaign activation, and performance measurement.
Support website content, SEO, and AI visibility, such as AEO/AIO, along with landing pages, and digital experiences that improve visibility, engagement, and conversion.
Conduct market, customer, audience, and competitive research and contribute insights that inform positioning, messaging, campaigns, and sales conversations.
Analyze marketing performance, market insights, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities and recommend improvements to marketing programs.
Manage multiple projects from planning through completion while maintaining quality, accuracy, organization, and deadlines.
Maintain the effectiveness and implementation of the MEDHOST Quality Management System and meet applicable regulatory requirements as needed.
Responsible for QMS procedures listed in QMS Procedure Crosswalk found in QMS Manual as applicable.
Other duties as assigned.

Requirements & Other Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
4+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience across product marketing, integrated marketing, digital marketing, messaging, demand generation, or go-to-market execution.
Healthcare technology, healthcare IT, enterprise technology, or similarly complex B2B experience preferred, with familiarity with healthcare industry terminology and market dynamics also preferred.
Experience supporting product launches, positioning, buyer messaging, and sales enablement, with a strong understanding of customer value and differentiation.
Practical proficiency using generative AI, prompting, and AI-assisted workflows in professional marketing.
Strong writing, editing, and messaging skills, including the ability to simplify complex healthcare, technology, and business concepts for different audiences.
Demonstrated ability to execute integrated and digital marketing across web, email, search, social media, and content channels, including SEO and emerging AI visibility practices such as AEO/AIO.
Familiarity with conducting market, audience, or competitive research and translating findings into actionable marketing recommendations.
Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, content management, analytics, research, and other marketing technology platforms.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and modern marketing productivity tools.
Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret marketing data and performance metrics to guide decisions and improvements.
Strong collaboration, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with peers, leadership, customers, partners, and vendors.
Strong project-management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to independently execute work within established strategic direction.
Adaptability, curiosity, and willingness to develop new capabilities as marketing practices and technology evolve.

What We Offer

Plenty of opportunities to grow your career
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, FSA benefits
3 weeks of vacation plus 5 personal days to recharge
401K and Life insurance benefits
Employee stock ownership and RRSP program
A chance to give back through community involvement
Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle

About Us

MEDHOST, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee, is a leading provider of healthcare information technology solutions. Serving healthcare facilities nationwide, MEDHOST offers a comprehensive suite of products, including electronic health records (EHR), financial management systems, and patient engagement platforms. Their mission is to empower healthcare organizations to enhance patient care and improve business operations through innovative, user-friendly solutions. In January 2024, MEDHOST was acquired by N. Harris Computer Corporation, further strengthening its position in the healthcare IT industry.
